audio.t: Hi Rosa, the tiles for the hotel lobby were supposed to arrive this morning, but the supplier just called. They're stuck at the border.
That's bad timing. The flooring team is scheduled to start tomorrow.
I know. Could we ask them to start on the upstairs bathrooms first? Those tiles are already here.
Good idea. I'll call their supervisor now and change the work order.

questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?
options: A supplier went out of business.
questions.evidence: They're stuck at the border.
questions.explanation: Les carrelages destinés au hall sont bloqués à la frontière : la livraison est retardée.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
options: Changing the order of the work
questions.evidence: Could we ask them to start on the upstairs bathrooms first?
questions.explanation: Il propose de commencer par les salles de bains de l'étage, dont les carrelages sont déjà livrés.
questions.takeaway: Start on X first = commencer par X.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do next?
questions.evidence: I'll call their supervisor now
questions.explanation: Elle appellera le chef d'équipe pour modifier l'ordre de travail.

audio.t: Our subscription to the financial newspaper ends this month. Should we renew it?
Hardly anyone reads the paper copies anymore. They just pile up in the break room.
But the analysts use the online archive every day for their reports.
Then let's switch to a digital-only subscription. It's cheaper, and it includes the archive.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.evidence: Our subscription to the financial newspaper ends this month. Should we renew it?
questions.explanation: Ils se demandent s'il faut renouveler l'abonnement au journal financier.

questions.prompt: Why does the first man say, "They just pile up in the break room"?
options: To suggest a new location for the papers
To complain that the break room is messy
To ask someone to clean the room
To show that the print copies are not read
questions.evidence: They just pile up in the break room.
questions.explanation: Les exemplaires papier s'entassent sans être lus : l'abonnement papier est peu utile.

questions.prompt: What does the woman decide?
options: To ask the analysts to pay
questions.evidence: let's switch to a digital-only subscription
questions.explanation: Elle opte pour un abonnement uniquement numérique, moins cher et avec les archives.

audio.t: I'm booking hotels for the trade show. Our limit is one hundred and fifty euros a night.
Make sure breakfast is included. We'll be at the booth from seven every morning.
OK. And I'd prefer something within a ten-minute walk, since we'll be carrying samples.
Sounds good. Book three rooms, please.

questions.prompt: Why does the man want breakfast included?
questions.evidence: We'll be at the booth from seven every morning.
questions.explanation: Ils seront au stand dès 7 h chaque matin : le petit-déjeuner à l'hôtel est pratique.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which hotel will the woman most likely book?
questions.explanation: Moins de 150 €, petit-déjeuner inclus, à 10 minutes à pied maximum : Parkside Inn (120 €).
questions.traps: Hotel Arno dépasse le budget ; City Lodge n'inclut pas le petit-déjeuner.

questions.prompt: How many rooms does the man ask for?
questions.evidence: Book three rooms, please.
questions.explanation: L'homme demande de réserver trois chambres pour l'équipe du salon.

audio.t: Mr. Laval from Orion Logistics called again. He says the software update we installed last week has slowed down their system.
That's the third complaint about that update. Did he say which features are affected?
Mainly the reporting tool. Some reports take ten minutes to load.
Let's send Ines to their office tomorrow morning. She developed that tool, so she'll find the problem quickly.

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Laval's complaint?
questions.evidence: has slowed down their system
questions.explanation: La mise à jour a ralenti le système du client.

questions.prompt: What does the man imply about the update?
options: Other customers have had problems with it.
It was developed by Mr. Laval.
questions.evidence: That's the third complaint about that update.
questions.explanation: C'est la troisième plainte : d'autres clients ont eu des problèmes.

questions.prompt: Why will Ines visit the client?
questions.evidence: She developed that tool
questions.explanation: Elle a développé l'outil de reporting, elle trouvera vite le problème.

audio.t: Hello, I'd like to register for the Packaging Innovation Fair, but your website says registration is closed.
Online registration ended yesterday, but you can still register at the entrance on the first day.
Is the price the same?
It's twenty euros more at the door. But if you're a member of the packaging association, you'll get the member rate.

questions.prompt: Why is the man calling?
options: He wants to exhibit at a fair.
He wants to register for an event.
questions.evidence: I'd like to register for the Packaging Innovation Fair
questions.explanation: Il veut s'inscrire au salon, mais l'inscription en ligne est close.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about registering on site?
options: It must be done by phone.
questions.evidence: It's twenty euros more at the door.
questions.explanation: S'inscrire sur place coûte 20 € de plus.
questions.takeaway: At the door = sur place, à l'entrée.

questions.prompt: Who could avoid the extra charge?
questions.evidence: if you're a member of the packaging association, you'll get the member rate
questions.explanation: Les membres de l'association bénéficient du tarif adhérent, même sur place.

audio.t: I'd like to take a week off in August. Is there a period when at least three of us will be here?
Let's see. We need three people in the office at all times for the client hotline.
What about the first week, from the first to the seventh?

Clara is off then, so if you also leave, only two of us would remain. Try the week of the eighth instead... no, Malik's away. Hmm, honestly, the only week that works is the last one, but Yann is off too.

questions.prompt: What does the man want to do?
questions.evidence: I'd like to take a week off in August.
questions.explanation: Il veut prendre une semaine de congé en août.
questions.takeaway: Take a week off = prendre une semaine de congé.

questions.prompt: Why must three people be in the office?
questions.evidence: We need three people in the office at all times for the client hotline.
questions.explanation: Trois personnes doivent être présentes pour assurer la ligne d'assistance client.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply in her last statement?
options: The man should take two weeks off.
Finding a suitable week will be difficult.
The hotline will close in August.
questions.evidence: the only week that works is the last one, but Yann is off too
questions.explanation: Elle passe en revue les semaines et aucune ne convient vraiment : il sera difficile de trouver une semaine.
questions.takeaway: Hmm, honestly… = hésitation qui annonce une difficulté.

audio.t: I've been comparing office supply companies. PaperPlus offers free next-day delivery on all orders.
That's convenient. But are their prices competitive?
They're about five percent higher than our current supplier, but we'd save on delivery fees, which we pay every week now.
Then let's try them for a month and compare the total costs.

questions.prompt: What does PaperPlus offer?
questions.evidence: PaperPlus offers free next-day delivery on all orders
questions.explanation: PaperPlus propose la livraison gratuite le lendemain.

questions.prompt: Why might PaperPlus be cheaper overall?
options: The company would no longer pay delivery fees.
questions.evidence: we'd save on delivery fees, which we pay every week now
questions.explanation: Les produits coûtent 5 % de plus, mais l'économie sur les frais de livraison hebdomadaires pourrait compenser.
questions.traps: (B) est faux : les prix sont plus élevés.

questions.prompt: What do the speakers decide to do?
questions.evidence: let's try them for a month and compare the total costs
questions.explanation: Ils testeront PaperPlus pendant un mois avant de comparer.
questions.takeaway: Try for a month = tester pendant un mois.

audio.t: Our presentation to the city council is on Monday. Is everything ready?
The slides are done, but we're still waiting for the updated traffic data from the engineering firm.
I called them this morning. They promised to send it by Friday noon.
That's cutting it close. Let's schedule a rehearsal for Friday afternoon so we can include the new figures.

questions.prompt: Who will the speakers present to?
questions.evidence: Our presentation to the city council is on Monday.
questions.explanation: Ils présentent lundi devant le conseil municipal.

questions.prompt: What does the man mean when he says, "That's cutting it close"?
options: There is little time left before the deadline.
questions.evidence: That's cutting it close.
questions.explanation: Recevoir les données vendredi midi pour une présentation lundi laisse très peu de marge.
questions.takeaway: Cut it close = avoir très peu de marge.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
questions.evidence: Let's schedule a rehearsal for Friday afternoon
questions.explanation: Il propose une répétition vendredi après-midi pour intégrer les nouveaux chiffres.

audio.t: Good morning, passengers, and welcome aboard the 8:15 service to Strasbourg. We will be stopping at Dijon and Mulhouse. The café car is located in the middle of the train and is open until 11 A.M. Please note that due to a signal problem near Dijon, we expect to arrive in Strasbourg about fifteen minutes late. Passengers with connections should speak to a member of staff, who will help them find an alternative if necessary.

questions.prompt: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.evidence: welcome aboard the 8:15 service to Strasbourg
questions.explanation: Arrêts, voiture-bar, problème de signalisation : on est dans un train.

questions.prompt: Why will the arrival be delayed?
questions.evidence: due to a signal problem near Dijon
questions.explanation: Un problème de signalisation près de Dijon retardera l'arrivée d'environ 15 minutes.

questions.prompt: What should passengers with connections do?
questions.evidence: Passengers with connections should speak to a member of staff
questions.explanation: Ils doivent s'adresser à un agent qui les aidera à trouver une solution.

audio.t: I'd like to briefly go over our new travel policy, which starts next month. From now on, all business trips under four hours by train must be made by train rather than by plane. I know some of you like to fly to Marseille because it feels faster. But once you count the time to get to the airport and go through security, the train is usually quicker. The new policy will also help us meet our goal of reducing emissions by thirty percent. Any exceptions will need approval from your director.

questions.prompt: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.evidence: our new travel policy, which starts next month
questions.explanation: L'oratrice présente la nouvelle politique de déplacements professionnels.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker mention the time needed to get to the airport?
options: To argue that the train is often faster
questions.evidence: the train is usually quicker
questions.explanation: En comptant le trajet vers l'aéroport et la sécurité, le train est souvent plus rapide : c'est un argument pour la nouvelle règle.
questions.takeaway: Once you count… = si l'on compte…

questions.prompt: What is required for an exception?
questions.evidence: Any exceptions will need approval from your director.
questions.explanation: Toute exception doit être approuvée par le directeur.

audio.t: Welcome back to Career Moves, the podcast for young professionals. Today's topic is salary negotiation. Many people accept the first offer they receive because they're afraid of losing the job. In reality, most employers expect some negotiation. My guest today, recruiter Alicia Moreno, has hired more than five hundred people in the past ten years. She'll share three simple steps to prepare. And at the end of the show, she'll answer questions sent in by our listeners.

questions.prompt: What is the topic of today's episode?
questions.evidence: Today's topic is salary negotiation.
questions.explanation: L'épisode porte sur la négociation salariale.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about employers?
questions.evidence: most employers expect some negotiation
questions.explanation: La plupart des employeurs s'attendent à une négociation.

questions.prompt: What will happen at the end of the show?
options: A contest winner will be named.
A job offer will be announced.
A new guest will be introduced.
questions.evidence: she'll answer questions sent in by our listeners
questions.explanation: L'invitée répondra aux questions des auditeurs.

audio.t: Hi Daniel, it's Nora. I visited the coworking space this morning, and I think it's perfect for us while the office is being renovated. Since there will just be the two of us, we don't need a team office. But we'll need a private space for client calls, and we usually have about six hours of meetings a month. The option that matches that is within our budget, so I'll sign up this afternoon unless you have objections.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker need a coworking space?
options: They are starting a new company.
They are moving to a new city.
questions.evidence: while the office is being renovated
questions.explanation: Leurs bureaux sont en rénovation : ils ont besoin d'un espace temporaire.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which option will the speaker most likely choose?

questions.traps: Fixed n'offre qu'un bureau réservé (non privé) et 4 h de salle.

questions.prompt: What will the speaker do this afternoon?
questions.evidence: I'll sign up this afternoon unless you have objections
questions.explanation: Elle s'inscrira cet après-midi sauf objection de Daniel.

sets.title: Annonce de remise de prix interne

audio.t: Before we close today's meeting, I'm pleased to announce this year's Employee of the Year award. It goes to Fatima Benali from our customer service team. Fatima reorganized the way we handle complaints, and as a result, the average response time dropped from three days to under twenty-four hours. She also trained six new team members this year. Fatima, the award comes with an extra week of paid vacation, which I'm sure you'll enjoy.

questions.prompt: What is being announced?
questions.evidence: this year's Employee of the Year award
questions.explanation: L'orateur annonce la récompense de l'employée de l'année.

questions.prompt: What did Ms. Benali achieve?
questions.evidence: the average response time dropped from three days to under twenty-four hours
questions.explanation: Le délai moyen de réponse est passé de trois jours à moins de 24 heures.

questions.prompt: What will Ms. Benali receive?
questions.evidence: the award comes with an extra week of paid vacation
questions.explanation: La récompense inclut une semaine de congés payés supplémentaire.

audio.t: Hello, Mr. Okafor, this is Jade from Pixel Print. I'm calling about your order of conference programs. Unfortunately, our main printing machine broke down yesterday, and the replacement part won't arrive until Thursday. Your programs will now be ready on Friday morning instead of Wednesday. I know your conference starts on Friday afternoon, so we'll deliver them directly to the venue by noon, free of charge. Please call me back if that doesn't work for you.

questions.prompt: Why will the order be late?
questions.evidence: our main printing machine broke down yesterday
questions.explanation: La machine d'impression principale est tombée en panne.

To ask for the conference schedule
To show that the delivery plan takes the event into account

questions.explanation: Elle tient compte du début de la conférence et propose une livraison sur place avant midi.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker offer?
questions.evidence: we'll deliver them directly to the venue by noon, free of charge
questions.explanation: Elle propose de livrer gratuitement les programmes sur le lieu de la conférence.

audio.t: Welcome to Channel 7's studios. In a moment, we'll walk through the newsroom, where our journalists prepare the evening news. Please keep your voices down, as they're working on tight deadlines. After that, you'll see the main studio. If we're lucky, you might watch a short live weather report. Photos are allowed everywhere except in the control room. The tour finishes at the gift shop, where you can buy souvenirs.

audio.t: Here are the results of last month's customer survey. The good news is that complaints about product quality are now the least common. As you can see, the biggest issue is how long customers wait on the phone. We've already hired four new agents, who start next week. For the second biggest problem, I'd like the logistics team to propose solutions by the end of the month.
